items.reason: Gap 0 explicitly describes overlapping deliveries both passing the in-memory check before the ID is added, causing duplicate processing.
Gap 2 says the deduplication key comes from the unsigned X-Event-Id header and that changing or forging it lets a duplicate through.
Gap 3 states that the provider sends charge.refunded but the only refund handler is registered as refund.created, causing refunds to be dropped.
No gap alleges a problem that depends on multiple processes, instances, or replicas.
